rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact bar/courtyard mass across views, with a dominant linear gesture and a meaningful carved void that aligns with the neighborhood-living brief. The void is legible in plan and section enough to count as a public threshold, and the mass does not visibly self-collide across views. The main weakness is section richness: the silhouette is somewhat generic and boxy, with only modest relief at roof/upper edge, so it supports the program plausibly but not strongly. The verified access edge is answered by an open cut/courtyard logic rather than a sealed front, which is appropriate. Overall it is program-fit and repairable, with precedent resonance strongest in courtyard/bar and interlocking-wing references.
